sourceObservations.text: ValidationTrigger declares 10 values but ON_CREATE, ON_ATTRIBUTE_CHANGE, ON_RELATION_CHANGE, ON_DELETE and BACKGROUND have no reader; FULL and INCREMENTAL runs ignore triggers (the mode decides). The designer offers all 10. AuthoritativeRepresentation JAVASCRIPT/BLOCKLY are missing from the designer options. relationInstanceId is never filled.

The editor session calls ValidationRuntimeApplicationService.validate directly, not the orchestrator, so no consolidation and no SAVE blocking decision in that flow. Save blocking on rule definitions exists only in the frontend.

Textual quick fix runtime (preview/apply) has endpoints but no frontend caller, no dedicated tests and no undo/redo. Grammar code actions are a separate subsystem with no bridge to the model quick fix runtime. No test instantiates QuickFixRuntimeService.

Per-session gating flags (hydra.eventsEnabled/eventFlowsEnabled/gamificationEnabled) are written into the event PAYLOAD but consumers read them from event METADATA and the publisher never copies them: per-session disables never reach consumers (static reading; runtime not executed).

core.model.element-reparented is published by the session but is absent from ReservedEventCatalog (32 ids), so a flow trigger on it fails UNKNOWN_TRIGGER_EVENT. Several reserved ids have no literal producer (literal search only). Flow trace status is overwritten, not aggregated; ERROR_END is pass-through; COMPENSATES transition and EventPersistencePolicy have no consumer.

Operator NOT_EXISTS is supported by the backend matcher but absent from the designer operator list. Only a global feedback policy editor exists (no per-rule keys UI). Surfaces STATUS/PROGRESS/DIALOG have no consumer. No test for GamificationFeedbackCenter or the HTTP /runtime/events path.

TransformationExecutionPolicy.mode (BATCH/INCREMENTAL) is never read at runtime; incremental is chosen per synchronization request; the frontend type is BATCH only. Batch BOTH with FAIL_ON_CONFLICT throws while incremental returns a blocked result. No end-to-end tests of the incremental engine or session service.
The textual language service has no UI consumer; capabilities() is not provider-aware and reports all 11 capabilities available for any grammar (ANTLR does not declare them).
metamodel/roundtrip and textual/roundtrip services are only reachable from tests.
EditorDefinitionDesigner declares an ELEMENTS view with no render branch; which representation kinds the runtime renders is unverified.
Wizard step 2-6 fields, delivery-mode values, target/injection restrictions and the integration<->publication/recovery relations are inherited from the validated legacy cache, not re-read.
Release gate (5 checks), code generation dialog, publication wizard (5 steps), generated-project stages and execution profiles are inherited from the validated legacy cache, not re-read.
